description: Committed R47 and R48 readings used to prove that two dispatches are not a within-run pair. Sources: AUDIT 34.35, TECH-DESIGN 17.98, COMPETITIVE L.16, prereg/R48-u3-coverage-floor.md and prereg/R47-coverage-histogram.md. The storeFingerprint values here are the documented store identities ('8 distilled items' vs '12 distilled items'), not sha256 digests: a real dispatch must attest the actual digest of its one distilled store. The l4Paired rows are the within-run memory-vs-reference gate, NEVER the facade contribution: R48's -6.00pp gate fired the R45 revert rule while the cross-run contribution was a different quantity.

identityControl.description: Structural identity control, NOT a measurement. Both facades carry the same scope, the same task ids and the same outcomes, so a valid pair must report a zero delta. It exists to prove the invariant admits a within-run pair without inventing an experimental result.
